item.description: An object representing the information about a test class, the corresponding focal class, and the oracles datapoints (pairs of test prefixes and target oracles) extracted from the test cases of the original test class

datapoints.description: A list of oracles data points (pairs of test prefixes defined within the test class and the corresponding target oracles)

testClass.description: The information related to the test class

identifier.description: The name of the test class

packageIdentifier.description: The fully qualified name of the package where the test class is located

superclasses.description: A list of strings containing the fully qualified names of the extended classes

items.description: The fully qualified name of the extended class

interfaces.description: A list of strings containing the fully qualified names of the implemented interfaces

items.description: The fully qualified name of the interfaces implemented interface

filePath.description: The full path to the test class file, within the project

prefixFilePath.description: The full path to the test prefix class file, within the project

fields.description: A list of declared fields in the test class

auxiliaryMethods.description: A list of methods defined in the test class to support the test cases defined within it (like mock generators or methods with assertions shared among the different test cases

setupTearDownMethods.description: A list of methods defined in the test class to support the test cases setup and tear down

testCases.description: A list of methods representing the test cases defined within the test class

field.description: The information related to a field defined within a class

fullSignature.description: The full signature of the field

declarator.description: The declarator part of the full signature of the field

modifiers.description: A list with the modifiers that identify the field

callable.description: The information related to a callable object (a method - even a test case - or a constructor)

identifier.description: The name of the method or constructor

annotations.description: A list of annotations identifying the method or constructor

modifiers.description: A list with the modifiers that identify the method

signature.description: The signature of the method or constructor

thrownExceptions.description: The list of exceptions that the methods can throw

items.description: The name of the exception class

parameters.description: The list of parameters of the method or constructor

items.description: The information related to the parameter object

javadoc.description: The javadoc of the method or constructor. Can be empty

body.description: The signature and the body of the method

invokedMethods.description: The list of invoked methods within the current method or constructor. Can be set to null to avoid infinite recursion

referenceType.description: The information related to the type of a field or a method parameter, or the return type of a method

fullyQualifiedIdentifiers.description: A list containing the fully qualified identifier of the type. The fully qualified identifier is a single value, but if the algorithm is not able to retrieve it with Java Parser and Symbol Solver, it looks at any class with the same name within the project (this can lead to multiple values).

items.description: The fully qualified name of the related type

isVoid.description: If the current type refers to a return type of a method, it could be a void type: in this case the boolean value is set to True

isPrimitive.description: If the type is a primitive type, like `int`, `float`, `bool`

isGeneric.description: If the type is a generic (like <T>, <R>)

arrayLevel.description: It the type represents an array (1) or a matrix (2) or a complex n-dimensional array (n). The value is set to 0 if the type is not an array.

clazzes.description: A list containing the information about the reference class of the given type. The class is a single object, but if the algorithm is not able to retrieve it with Java Parser and Symbol Solver, it looks at any class with the same name within the project (this can lead to multiple values).

class.description: The information related to the source class (like the focal class)

identifier.description: The name of the source class

packageIdentifier.description: The fully qualified name of the package where the source class is located

superclasses.description: A list of strings containing the fully qualified names of the extended classes

items.description: The fully qualified name of the extended class

interfaces.description: A list of strings containing the fully qualified names of the implemented interfaces

items.description: The fully qualified name of the interfaces implemented interface

filePath.description: The full path to the class file, within the project

fields.description: A list of declared fields in the source class

constructors.description: A list of constructors defined in the source class to instanciate an object

methods.description: A list of methods defined in the source class

oracleDatapoint.description: The information related to an oracle datapoint (a pair of test prefix and target oracle)
